nina_sales: Quick: DeepWave wants Redwood Private behind their perimeter NGFW. Requirements: preserve client src IP for their SIEM, get a stable small set of egress IPs for allowlisting during a 30-day POC, and ensure mTLS endpoints work. Thoughts?
arjun_se: Short: doable. Two patterns: routed peering/transit (preserves src IP, supports mTLS passthrough) or PrivateLink (easy but NATs to ENI; src IP lost).
mike_netops: Operational notes:
- Peering: establish TGW/VPC peering + BGP. Need to accept our ASN and advertise return routes, watch for asymmetric routing.
- PrivateLink: create interface endpoint in customer VPC; callbacks originate from endpoint ENI IP.

arjun_se: TLS inspect by NGFW will break mTLS and client cert passthrough. Recommend adding redwood service hostnames to NGFW bypass for mTLS flows, or deploy an internal proxy that forwards X-Forwarded-For.

nina_sales: Can we provide static EIPs for the POC? Pricing hit?
arjun_se: Yes — temporary reserved EIP set for POC possible. Small infra surcharge because it reduces egress pooling efficiency. For production, dedicated capacity gives stable IPs and SLA.

mike_netops: Minimal firewall allowlist snippet to give them: allow outbound TCP/443 to <REDACTED_RESRVD_EIPS>; allow UDP/123 to our NTP pool if needed; allow DNS (UDP/53 or DoT 853) as required. If using PrivateLink, allow inbound from interface endpoint ENI CIDR to app subnets for callbacks.

zoe_cs: Security blurb for questionnaire: "Redwood Private supports routed peering (recommended for preserving client source IP and mTLS passthrough) or interface PrivateLink (interface endpoints NAT to the endpoint IP). Temporary static egress IPs can be allocated for POCs; production-grade static IPs are provided with Dedicated deployments. If customer NGFW performs TLS inspection, we recommend bypassing Redwood hostnames for flows requiring client certificate validation or deploying an internal proxy that preserves client identity via X-Forwarded-For."

infra-bot: Ticket RWD-9001 created: "Reserve POC EIP set - DeepWave". ETA 48 business hours. Owner: arjun_se. Billing: POC infra surcharge applies.

nina_sales: Thanks team. I'll ask DeepWave to pick topology and send their security questionnaire. Zoe, pls include the firewall snippet in the invite.

zoe_cs: Will do. Scheduling handoff with their netsec for Tue 2pm PT.

nina_sales: Great, thanks :thumbsup:
